CoreGuiEnabler.luau.description: Key based CoreGuiEnabler, singleton Use this class to load/unload CoreGuis / other GUIs, by disabling based upon keys Keys are additive, so if you have more than 1 disabled, it's ok. Public entry points include `CoreGuiEnabler.new`, `CoreGuiEnabler.IsEnabled`, `CoreGuiEnabler.ObserveIsEnabled`, `CoreGuiEnabler.AddState`, `CoreGuiEnabler.Disable`, `CoreGuiEnabler.PushDisable`, `CoreGuiEnabler.Enable`.
